title: Anderdingus
blurb: Anderdingus — another entry in the internet's collection of names too stupid to be real and too funny to forget. It belongs to the same absurdist family as Quandale Dingle: characters who exist purely because their names are hilarious. Play it as a greeting, an insult, or an introduction to someone who deserves neither.
origin: A goofy-ahh-genre character name in the Quandale Dingle tradition.
